ASTM D3035.title: Standard Specification for Polyethylene (PE) Plastic Pipe (DR-PR) Based on Controlled Outside Diameter
ASTM D3035.gfr_citation: GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii) prohibits mandating foreign standard ASTM D3035 when national standard IS 4984:2016 is in force.
ASTM D3035.advisory: Convert ASTM D3035 to national equivalent IS 4984:2016 with mandatory ISI marking as per DPIIT QCO 2021.

ASTM A615.title: Standard Specification for Deformed and Plain Carbon-Steel Bars for Concrete Reinforcement
ASTM A615.gfr_citation: GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii) prohibits mandating foreign standard ASTM A615 when national standard IS 1786:2008 (High strength deformed steel bars Fe500D) is in force.
ASTM A615.advisory: Mandate IS 1786:2008 Grade Fe 500D with mandatory BIS license under Steel QCO 2012.

ASTM A36.title: Standard Specification for Carbon Structural Steel
ASTM A36.gfr_citation: Specify IS 2062:2011 Grade E250. ASTM A36 without BIS standard mark violates Steel QCO 2020 and GFR 144(vii).
ASTM A36.advisory: Replace ASTM A36 with IS 2062:2011 Grade E250 Quality A/B.

ASTM D1785.title: Standard Specification for Poly(Vinyl Chloride) (PVC) Plastic Pipe, Schedules 40, 80, and 120
ASTM D1785.gfr_citation: Under GFR Rule 144(vii), uPVC pressure pipes must cite IS 4985:2021 rather than US Schedule 40/80 standards.
ASTM D1785.advisory: Convert to IS 4985:2021 Class 3 (0.6 MPa) or Class 4 (1.0 MPa).

DIN 8074.title: Polyethylene (PE) Pipes - PE 80, PE 100 - Dimensions
DIN 8074.gfr_citation: Under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii), DIN 8074 dimensions are covered under national standard IS 4984:2016 SDR series (SDR 17 / SDR 11).
DIN 8074.advisory: Substitute DIN 8074 with IS 4984:2016 with mandatory ISI Mark.

DIN 17100.title: Steels for General Structural Purposes
DIN 17100.gfr_citation: Under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii), DIN 17100 St 37-2 / St 52-3 must be converted to national equivalent IS 2062:2011 E250 / E350.

ISO 4427.title: Plastics piping systems — Polyethylene (PE) pipes and fittings for water supply
ISO 4427.gfr_citation: Under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii), national standard IS 4984:2016 must be specified. Physical products must bear valid BIS License (ISI Mark).
ISO 4427.advisory: Cite IS 4984:2016 conforming to ISO 4427 parameters with mandatory ISI mark.

ISO 1452.title: Plastics piping systems for water supply — Unplasticized poly(vinyl chloride) (PVC-U)
ISO 1452.gfr_citation: National standard IS 4985:2021 takes precedence under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii).

BS 1387.title: Specification for Screwed and Socketed Steel Tubes and Tubulars
BS 1387.gfr_citation: Under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii), British Standard BS 1387 is superseded in India by national standard IS 1239 (Part 1):2004.
BS 1387.advisory: Substitute BS 1239 / BS 1387 with IS 1239 (Part 1):2004 Medium/Heavy class.

BS 6004.title: Electric cables — PVC insulated and PVC sheathed cables for power and lighting
BS 6004.gfr_citation: Under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii), mandatory Indian Standard IS 694:2010 applies over British Standard BS 6004.
BS 6004.advisory: Substitute BS 6004 with IS 694:2010 with ISI mark.

IEC 60076.title: Power Transformers — General and Temperature Rise
IEC 60076.gfr_citation: Under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii), distribution transformers in India must cite IS 1180 (Part 1):2014 with mandatory BEE Star Labeling.
IEC 60076.advisory: Specify IS 1180 (Part 1):2014 with mandatory BEE Energy Efficiency rating.

IEC 60502.title: Power cables with extruded insulation and their accessories for rated voltages from 1 kV up to 30 kV
IEC 60502.gfr_citation: Under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii), cite IS 7098 (Part 1) for LT cables or IS 7098 (Part 2) for HT cables under Cables QCO 2021.
IEC 60502.advisory: Specify IS 7098 with mandatory ISI Mark.

IEC 61111.title: Live working — Electrical insulating matting
IEC 61111.gfr_citation: Under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii), Central Electricity Authority (CEA) strictly enforces IS 15652:2006 over foreign IEC 61111.
IEC 61111.advisory: Convert IEC 61111 to IS 15652:2006 Class A/B/C with mandatory ISI Mark.

ISO 20345.title: Personal protective equipment — Safety footwear
ISO 20345.gfr_citation: Under GFR 2017 Rule 144(vii), IS 15298 (Part 2):2016 is an identical adoption of ISO 20345 and mandatory under DPIIT Footwear QCO 2020.
ISO 20345.advisory: Specify IS 15298 (Part 2):2016 with mandatory ISI Mark.
